description: This file defines a generic interface 'Entry<T>' representing a cache entry, including static factory methods for creating different types of entries (permanent, based on revision, nonexistent), and methods to access entry properties such as revision, existence, and value.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: A generic interface for cache entries, handling revisioning, existence, and retrieval of cached values.

methods.name: permanent
methods.description: Creates a cache entry that is considered permanent with the maximum revision value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a cache entry with a specific revision and value.

methods.name: nonexistent
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing a non-existent cache entry.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the cache entry.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if the cache entry exists.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the cached value if present; throws NoSuchElementException otherwise.
